title: Danish post office delivers last letter, ending a 400-year run to adapt to the digital age
summary: It's the end of an era for the Danish post office. Citing a 90% drop in letter-sending over the past quarter-century, PostNord has ended delivering paper letters in the country, a service first started in 1624.
